name: camayoc_gp_dead_ends
description: golden-paths Q7: the hazards of one golden path - abandoned branches its exemplars explored that did not help. Pruned is not deleted; a follower should know what was tried.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?step ?label WHERE { <{path}> aegis:deadEnd ?step . ?step rdfs:label ?label } ORDER BY ?label
